page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.12xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8475B processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced resource allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance as a stable resource pool for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of specialized hardware. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include enterprise web applications, medium-sized databases, containerized microservices, and general-purpose application servers.
